_comment: Diagnostic retrieval case set. v1 (rag_retrieval_cases.json) is kept intact
as the comparison baseline; this file does not replace it.
Every query carries a `trap` category so failures are diagnosable rather than
just countable. The categories name the specific confusion each query is
lexical_trap     - shares surface tokens with an unrelated cluster
valence_flip     - same topic, opposite emotional valence
temporal         - same situation before vs after resolution
same_topic_facet - same life domain, different facet (workload vs colleague)
semantic_neighbor- adjacent feeling from a different cause (sleep vs exercise fatigue)
k=3 matches the app's production RETRIEVAL_TOP_K so these numbers describe
Caveat on P@k: relevant-set cardinality varies (1 or 2) across queries, so
P@3 is capped below 1.0 for single-relevant queries and is NOT comparable
across them. Read Recall@k and MRR as the headline metrics.

documents.text: My manager piled three deadlines on me and I stayed late again, totally burned out.
Another twelve hour day at the office. The workload keeps growing and I cannot keep up.
My colleague took credit for my work in the meeting and I said nothing.
Tense standup again. My teammate keeps talking over me and I feel invisible at work.
Shipped the feature today and my manager actually thanked me in front of the team.
Sent out ten applications today and got another rejection email. The job hunt is exhausting.
Third rejection this week. I keep wondering if I will ever get hired anywhere.
Got a callback for a second interview. First bit of hope in the job search in weeks.
I have barely slept in days, lying awake at 3am with my mind racing.
Another restless night. I keep waking up exhausted and foggy in the morning.
Slept eight hours straight for the first time in a month and woke up clear headed.
Started a morning run habit and my energy is slowly coming back.
Skipped the gym all week and my body feels sluggish and tense.
Legs are dead after that long run today. Good tired, not bad tired.
We argued again about the same thing and I do not feel heard by my partner.
Another fight over nothing. I said things I regret and now we are not speaking.
Date night helped. We finally talked things through and I felt close to them again.
My closest friend cancelled on me for the third time and I am starting to feel disposable.
Long call with an old friend. Felt seen in a way I have not in months.
Called my mother and the conversation turned into a lecture again. I hung up drained.
My brother remembered the anniversary without being reminded. Small thing, meant a lot.
Grateful for the small things today: good coffee, a bit of sun, a walk with a friend.
I wrote down three good things that happened this week and felt lighter afterward.
Rent went up again and the numbers just do not work this month. Constant low level dread.
Paid off the last of the credit card. First time in two years the balance is zero.
I feel like a failure. Everyone else seems to have figured it out and I have not.
I keep replaying that mistake from the meeting. I cannot do anything right.
The test results come back Thursday and I have been catastrophizing all week.
Presentation tomorrow and my stomach is in knots. I am sure I will freeze up.
The presentation actually went fine. All that dread for nothing.
Packing up the apartment. Excited about the new city but grieving this one.
